body:
Filing gate: maintainer-directed task. Filed by the 18.2.0 release-assessment thread · `session_01G3h9iZTpL8aCiXbfsp8H5u`. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not dispatched.

**Maintainer's words** (project thread, 2026-10-25, verbatim): 22:54Z 「约 300 条清单准确性问题：是不是应该开卡？」, then 22:55Z 「写issue，不派发」.

**Parent:** wave anchor #25807 (18.2.0 release test sweep). RUNNER's extraction obligation parks checklist-accuracy findings on the anchor; the maintainer asked for them as issues, so the wave's findings are split into one card per ledger file and the anchor links each card. This is not a release blocker, so it carries no `target:v18`.

**Reader who acts:** the lane owning `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**` (`domain:devx`). Dedupe (open and closed): no card holds these lines; the 18.0 precedent closed its accuracy rows on its anchor #24579.

## Wanted

For each line below, edit `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ai.json`: revise the item's text, bump its `revision`, and append a `history` entry citing the run record the line comes from. Keep `pnpm check:platform-checklist` green. A line that turns out to describe a product defect rather than stale text gets its own card instead of a ledger edit.

## Findings (14)

### From #25812 — `priority:P0`, 23 items, at `6679644a`, pin `b41ed7f68956`

- `ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed` steps 2 and 9: the INFO lines need `--log-level info` on `os start`; `query_records` caps `limit` at 50.

### From #25815 — `release-18.2.0-tier1`, 156 items, at `6679644a`, pin `b41ed7f68956` (clause labels: aK = acceptance[K], nK = negative[K])

- `ai.mcp-coded-refusals-and-runtime-exposure` a1: packages/mcp/src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts ('<tool>: RECORD_NOT_FOUND from <member> answers code, message and status') asserts the clause at unit layer but is not in the ref
- `ai.mcp-coded-refusals-and-runtime-exposure` a2: no pin drives query_records on an apiEnabled:false runtime object across a restart; plugin-runtime-object-metadata-copy asserts the metadata copy/listing only
- `ai.mcp-http-surface` a3: the pin asserts status 401 only; the 'Unauthorized: a valid API key is required' wording and the OAuth WWW-Authenticate form are unasserted
- `ai.mcp-http-surface` a4: the pin's tool-discovery case uses a session bearer token (not an API key), skips initialize, and checks two tool names, not the documented 12
- `ai.mcp-http-surface` ref is bare (one file) while the item has six acceptance clauses: a0–a2 and a5 have no pin at any layer
- `ai.mcp-oauth-private-host-transport` a0-a4: item is api/log-oracle throughout but the only pin (auth-manager.mcp-oauth.test.ts) is a unit test of isOAuthEligibleBaseUrl / AuthManager getters — no booted server, no log capture; it corroborates the rule but scores no clause
- `ai.mcp-oauth-private-host-transport` a4: '… is reachable by no configuration key and no environment variable' (unit) covers the predicate half only
- `ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed` a0: the pin regex /OS_MCP_STDIO_API_KEY/ checks the var name only, not the remedy text nor 'the process does not serve'; scored from the verify's own oracle (plugin.start throws).
- `ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed` a1/a6/n4: no test in packages/mcp asserts the API_KEY_REVOKED arm (#23367) — grep for 'REVOKED' over packages/mcp tests finds none; ref is a single unit file for an item whose clauses are mostly live api/log.
- `ai.mcp-validate-expression` a2: pin never runs the SAME expression under both sites (flow_condition case uses a different expression than the formula bare-field case)
- `ai.mcp-validate-expression` a0/a1/a3: pin harness is a fake describeObject bridge, not the served MCP door the api oracle names
- `ai.skill-instructions-mcp-prompts` a3: verify cites skill-prompts.test.ts as the pin, but it drives only an unknown name ('no_such_skill') through a stub bridge; a non-projected (inactive or instruction-less) name on prompts/get is not asserted
- `ai.skill-instructions-mcp-prompts` n1: no pin asserts prompts/get refuses an inactive skill (only prompts/list omission is asserted)

## Acceptance

- Every line above is either applied (item revised, `revision` bumped, `history` cites the record) or answered on this card with the reason it was not.
- `pnpm check:platform-checklist` is green.
- The PR links this card and #25807.
